parameters.query:
--PPL instruments - get trigger from PD
drop table if exists ops.ppl_access_cross_data;
--
create table if not exists ops.ppl_access_cross_data as (
with input_pd as 
		(WITH emp_map(raw_type, t1aer, mapped_group) AS (
				    VALUES
				        ('Employee',                'Yes', 'Employees/Employees(EOR)/Contractors/Maternity&Unpaid Leave'),
				        ('Employee',                'No',  'Employees/Employees(EOR)/Contractors/Maternity&Unpaid Leave'),
				        ('Contractor',              'Yes', 'Employees/Employees(EOR)/Contractors/Maternity&Unpaid Leave'),
				        ('Contractor',              'No',  'Contractors'),
				        ('Lended resource',         'Yes', 'Lended Resources'),
				        ('Lended resource',         'No',  'Lended Resources'),
				        ('Account only',            'Yes', 'Account only'),
				        ('Account only',            'No',  'Account only'),
				        ('Offboarded',              'Yes', 'Offboarded'),
				        ('Offboarded',              'No',  'Offboarded'),
				        ('Maternity/ Unpaid Leave', 'Yes', 'Employees/Employees(EOR)/Contractors/Maternity&Unpaid Leave'),
				        ('Maternity/ Unpaid Leave', 'No',  'Employees/Employees(EOR)/Contractors/Maternity&Unpaid Leave'),
				        ('Outstaff',                'Yes', 'Outstaff'),
				        ('Outstaff',                'No',  'Outstaff'),
				        ('EOR',                     'Yes', 'Employees/Employees(EOR)/Contractors/Maternity&Unpaid Leave'),
				        ('EOR',                     'No',  'EOR by ACME')
				),
				mapped AS (
				    SELECT
				        pd.id,
				        pd.full_name,
				        pd.t1aer,
				        COALESCE(em.mapped_group, pd.type_) AS mapped_group,
				        daterange(pd.valid_from, pd.valid_to, '[]') AS valid_period
				    FROM ops.pd AS pd
				    LEFT JOIN emp_map AS em
				        ON em.raw_type = pd.type_
				       AND em.t1aer    = pd.t1aer
				    WHERE pd.valid_from <= pd.valid_to
				),
				aggregated AS (
				    SELECT
				        id,
				        full_name,
				        mapped_group,
				        t1aer,
				        range_agg(valid_period) AS valid_periods
				    FROM mapped
				    GROUP BY
				        id,
				        full_name,
				        mapped_group,
				        t1aer
				)
				SELECT
				    lower(period)     AS valid_from_,
				    upper(period) - 1 AS valid_to_,
				    id,
				    full_name         AS full_name_,
				    mapped_group,
				    t1aer
				FROM aggregated
				CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(valid_periods) AS periods(period)
				ORDER BY
				    id,
				    full_name,
				    lower(period))
select 
	ipd.valid_from_,
	ipd.valid_to_,
	ipd.id,
	ipd.full_name_,
	ipd.mapped_group,
	ipd.t1aer,
	m.access_type,
	m."access" as access_,
	case when m."access" in ('No') then 'Revoke'
		when m."access" in ('Default', 'Default ', 'Yes') then 'Grant'
		when m."access" in ('By request') then 'Request'
		when ipd.mapped_group in ('Offboarded') then 'Revoke all'
		else 'Error' end as action_
from input_pd as ipd
left join ops.ppl_access_matrix as m
	on ipd.mapped_group = m.mapped_group
	and ipd.t1aer = m.t1aer
where m."access" in ('No', 'Default', 'By request', 'Default ', 'Yes')
	or ipd.mapped_group in ('Offboarded')
order by 
	ipd.id,
	ipd.valid_from_);

--Кейс когда новый сотрудник
insert into ops.ppl_access_out
SELECT
	valid_from_,
	valid_to_,
	id,
	full_name_,
	mapped_group,
	t1aer,
	access_type,
	action_,
	'To do' as status_,
  access_,
  'api_bot' as executor_
FROM ops.ppl_access_cross_data c
WHERE 
		NOT EXISTS (
	    SELECT 1
	    FROM ops.ppl_access_in i
	    WHERE i.id = c.id
		)
	and action_ in ('Grant');

--Выгрузка данных в гугл шит из ops.ppl_access_out
select 
	to_char(valid_from_, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as valid_from_,
	to_char(valid_to_, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as valid_to_,
	id,
	full_name_,
	mapped_group,
	t1aer,
	access_type,
	action_,
	status_,
  access_,
  executor_,
  jira_link,
  comment_
from ops.ppl_access_out
order by 
	valid_from_,
	full_name_ ;

--Кейс когда нет изменений
insert into ops.ppl_access_out
select
	base_in.valid_from_,
	base_in.valid_to_,
	base_in.id,
	base_in.full_name_,
	base_in.mapped_group,
	base_in.t1aer,
	base_in.access_type,
	base_in.action_,
	base_in.status_,
  base_in.access_,
  base_in.executor_,
  base_in.jira_link,
  base_in.comment_
from ops.ppl_access_in as base_in
left join ops.ppl_access_cross_data as base_out
	on base_in.valid_from_ = base_out.valid_from_
	and base_in.valid_to_ = base_out.valid_to_
	and base_in.id = base_out.id
	and base_in.mapped_group = base_out.mapped_group
	and base_in.t1aer = base_out.t1aer
	and base_in.access_type = base_out.access_type
	--and base_out.access_ in ('Default', 'By request', 'Default ')
	and base_in.action_ = base_out.action_
where base_out.valid_from_ is not null;

--Кейс когда есть изменения (оверка на то что нужно предоставить)
insert into ops.ppl_access_out
select
	base_out.valid_from_,
	base_out.valid_to_,
	base_out.id,
	base_out.full_name_,
	base_out.mapped_group,
	base_out.t1aer,
	base_out.access_type,
	base_out.action_,
	'To do' as status_,
	--base_out.*,
  base_out.access_,
  'api_bot' as executor_
from ops.ppl_access_in as base_in
right join ops.ppl_access_cross_data as base_out
	on base_in.valid_from_ = base_out.valid_from_
	and base_in.valid_to_ = base_out.valid_to_
	and base_in.id = base_out.id
	and base_in.mapped_group = base_out.mapped_group
	and base_in.t1aer = base_out.t1aer
	and base_in.access_type = base_out.access_type
	--and base_out.access_ in ('Default', 'By request', 'Default ')
	--and base_out.action_ = 'Grant'
where base_in.valid_from_ is null
	and base_out.action_ = 'Grant'
	--and base_out.id = '173'
	;

--Кейс когда нужно убрать или наоборот предоставить доступ (либо матрица изменилась либо удалили строку почему-то)
insert into ops.ppl_access_out
select
	base_in.valid_from_,
	base_in.valid_to_,
	base_in.id,
	base_in.full_name_,
	base_in.mapped_group,
	base_in.t1aer,
	base_in.access_type,
	base_out.action_,
	'To do' as status_,
  base_out.access_,
  'api_bot' as executor_
from ops.ppl_access_in as base_in
left join ops.ppl_access_cross_data as base_out
	on base_in.valid_from_ = base_out.valid_from_
	and base_in.valid_to_ = base_out.valid_to_
	and base_in.id = base_out.id
	and base_in.mapped_group = base_out.mapped_group
	and base_in.t1aer = base_out.t1aer
	and base_in.access_type = base_out.access_type
	--and base_out.access_ in ('Default', 'By request', 'Default ')
	and base_in.action_ <> base_out.action_
where base_out.valid_from_ is not null;

--Кейс с увольнением, ставим на revoke все выданные ранее доступы
insert into ops.ppl_access_out
select distinct
	c.valid_from_,
	c.valid_to_,
	c.id,
	c.full_name_,
	c.mapped_group,
	c.t1aer,
	base_in.access_type,
	c.action_,
	'To do' as status_,
  c.access_,
  'api_bot' as executor_
from ops.ppl_access_cross_data as c
left join ops.ppl_access_in as base_in
	on base_in.valid_from_ < c.valid_from_
	--and base_in.valid_to_ = base_out.valid_to_
	and base_in.id = c.id
	--and base_in.mapped_group = base_out.mapped_group
	--and base_in.t1aer = base_out.t1aer
	--and base_in.access_type = base_out.access_type
	--and base_out.access_ in ('Default', 'By request', 'Default ')
	--and base_in.action_ = base_out.action_	
WHERE 
		NOT EXISTS (
	    SELECT 1
	    FROM ops.ppl_access_in i
	    WHERE i.id = c.id
	    	and i.valid_from_ = c.valid_from_
	    	and i.valid_to_ = c.valid_to_
	    	and i.mapped_group = c.mapped_group
	    	and i.t1aer = c.t1aer
		)
	and c.mapped_group in ('Offboarded')
	and base_in.action_ not in ('Revoke');

--Кейс по ранее уволенным - сохраняю все записи что были раньше
insert into ops.ppl_access_out
select * from ops.ppl_access_in pai 
where mapped_group in ('Offboarded');

parameters.query:
WITH processed_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    to_char(valid_from_, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as valid_from_,
    to_char(valid_to_, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as valid_to_,
    id,
    full_name_,
    mapped_group,
    t1aer,
    access_type,
    action_,
    -- Проверяем статус текущей (нижней) и предыдущей (верхней) строки
    CASE 
      WHEN status_ = 'To do' AND LAG(status_) OVER (
        PARTITION BY id, access_type, action_ 
        ORDER BY valid_from_ NULLS FIRST
      ) = 'Done' THEN 'Done'
      ELSE status_
    END as status_,
    access_,
    executor_,
    jira_link,
    comment_
  FROM ops.ppl_access_out
)
-- Выводим только уникальные строки
SELECT DISTINCT
  valid_from_,
  valid_to_,
  id,
  full_name_,
  mapped_group,
  t1aer,
  access_type,
  action_,
  status_,
  access_,
  executor_,
  jira_link,
  comment_
FROM processed_rows
ORDER BY 
  valid_from_,
  full_name_;
